## Checks

- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` passes
- [ ] New behaviour has tests; bug fixes have a regression test
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s` / `git rebase --signoff`)
- [ ] No secrets, keys, `.env` files or private URLs are included
- [ ] No third-party asset was added without a licence recorded in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`
- [ ] No real-money feature (deposit, withdrawal, cash-out, crypto rail, paid stake with withdrawable value)
- [ ] No scraped or redistributed market data
- [ ] Docs updated when behaviour, config or routes changed
